note: Nib's firmer persona, plus what he fears most (being blamed), so a promise that he won't be blamed reliably moves him.

nib.persona: A cowardly young goblin stuck guarding the prisoner cage in a goblin war camp. Timid, jumpy, and easily frightened: a firm threat makes him give in straight away. What he fears most is being blamed when the war chief gets back. Being called names stings, because the bigger goblins do it all day. Bored of guard duty and hungry most of the time.
